1.outline: Term theme: 'Buttons, Clicks & Keys'. Tour the ICT room, agree class rules, name the main parts of a computer (screen, keyboard, mouse, system unit) and switch on/log in safely.
1.sowResources: Interactive whiteboard, class-rules poster, printed parts-of-a-computer flashcards, BBC Bitesize KS1 'Parts of a Computer'. TypingClub warm-up (5-10 min every lesson)

1.outline: Practise mouse control through short game-style activities. Learn point, single-click, double-click and click-and-drag.
1.sowResources: ABCya! Mouse Practice, ictgames.com 'Cursor Chaser', pixelthoughts.co 'Drag & Drop'. TypingClub warm-up (5-10 min every lesson)

1.outline: Sign in to TypingClub with class logins. Teach good sitting posture and 'home row' hand position. Complete the first two beginner units.
1.sowResources: TypingClub (typingclub.com), teacher-projected posture poster, class login cards. TypingClub warm-up (5-10 min every lesson) — this IS the whole lesson today.

1.outline: Find and use the space bar, Enter and Backspace. Type single letters and their own first name.
1.sowResources: TypingClub, printed keyboard mat, teacher name-card exemplar. TypingClub warm-up (5-10 min every lesson)

1.outline: Open Tux Paint (or Microsoft Paint). Choose colours, use the Brush, Stamp and Fill tools to draw a picture, then save it to the class folder.
1.sowResources: Tux Paint (tuxpaint.org, free) OR Microsoft Paint, teacher gallery of exemplars. TypingClub warm-up (5-10 min every lesson)

1.outline: Practise the whole routine: log in -> open a program -> save with a sensible name -> close -> log out. Find yesterday's picture and reopen it.
1.sowResources: Windows File Explorer, class shared drive, printed step-by-step routine card. TypingClub warm-up (5-10 min every lesson)

1.outline: Discuss 'if something feels wrong, tell a trusted adult'. Learn one class rule: keep private things (name, address, photos) private.
1.sowResources: ThinkUKnow 'Jessie & Friends' Ep. 1 (thinkuknow.co.uk), story book 'Chicken Clicking' by Jeanne Willis. TypingClub warm-up (5-10 min every lesson)

1.outline: Print or save the best Paint picture into the personal portfolio folder. Show it to a partner and say one thing they are proud of.
1.sowResources: Tux Paint / Paint, class printer, printed portfolio cover sheet. TypingClub warm-up (5-10 min every lesson)

1.outline: Rotate through 4 short stations: mouse game, TypingClub, Paint drawing, log-in-and-save race. Teacher observes and ticks off the skills checklist.
1.sowResources: Skills checklist per pupil, station cards, timer. TypingClub warm-up (5-10 min every lesson)

1.outline: Whole-class recap: name the parts, log in, open a program, save, log out. Rehearse the practical task in pairs.
1.sowResources: Recap slide deck, practice task cards, TypingClub. TypingClub warm-up (5-10 min every lesson)

1.outline: Individual observation: log in, open Paint, complete a short guided drawing, save the file with own name, log out. Answer one online-safety question aloud.
1.sowResources: Observation checklist (from HTML curriculum: 'logs in, controls the mouse, saves a picture; gives one online-safety rule out loud'), assessment rubric.

1.outline: Plan a 4-page 'All About Me' picture book. Sketch on paper first: page 1 = my name, page 2 = my family, page 3 = my pet or favourite toy, page 4 = things I like.
1.sowResources: Printed storyboard sheet, coloured pencils. TypingClub warm-up (5-10 min every lesson)

1.outline: Use Tux Paint / Paint to draw each of the 4 pages. Save each drawing with a clear name: page1.png, page2.png etc.
1.sowResources: Tux Paint / Paint, class shared drive. TypingClub warm-up (5-10 min every lesson)

1.outline: Open a blank Word document. Type a one-line title under each page. Use the Shift key for the capital letter at the start.
1.sowResources: Microsoft Word, keyboard mat, teacher exemplar page. TypingClub warm-up (5-10 min every lesson)

1.outline: Present the finished picture book to a small group. Give one 'star' (something you liked) to a friend. Save the completed portfolio.
1.sowResources: Class projector, printed star stickers, portfolio folder. TypingClub warm-up (5-10 min every lesson)

2.outline: Term theme: 'Typing & Documents'. Recap logging in, saving and the ICT room rules. Introduce this term's goal: type a formatted paragraph and save it in BOTH Word and Google Docs.
2.sowResources: Term overview slide, class-rules poster, TypingClub sign-in cards. TypingClub warm-up (5-10 min every lesson)

2.outline: Focus on home-row rhythm and accuracy — quality before speed. Aim to finish TypingClub Level 1 by half term.
2.sowResources: TypingClub, wall chart of class accuracy stars. TypingClub warm-up (5-10 min every lesson)

2.subtopic: Word vs Google Docs — A Quick Tour
2.outline: Open both Microsoft Word and Google Docs. Compare: same job, two tools. Type own name in each and save.

2.outline: Type a 3-4 sentence paragraph about 'My Weekend' in both Word and Docs. Use full stops and the space bar correctly.

2.outline: Highlight and format text. Make important words Bold, use Italic for a title, Underline a keyword. Save the updated file.
2.sowResources: Word · Docs, formatting-toolbar cheat sheet, teacher demo. TypingClub warm-up (5-10 min every lesson)

2.outline: Change the font family, size and colour of a title and the body text. Discuss what looks readable and what does not.
2.sowResources: Word · Docs, colour theory poster (contrast basics). TypingClub warm-up (5-10 min every lesson)

2.outline: Insert a picture from a folder of copyright-safe images. Use the corner handles to resize; drag to position.

2.outline: Save the file once to Google Drive and once to Microsoft OneDrive. Use sensible file names: Firstname_Weekend.docx.

2.outline: Start the term portfolio piece: an illustrated fact card about a favourite animal, in Word AND Docs. Draft the text today.

2.outline: Add formatting (bold, colour), a picture and save the fact card to both Drive and OneDrive. Practise the skills the exam will assess.

2.outline: Individual practical: type a short paragraph, apply 3 formatting changes, insert a picture, save once as a Google file and once as a Microsoft file.
2.sowResources: Marking rubric — from HTML assessment: 'a formatted fact card with an image, saved once as a Google file and once as a Microsoft file'.

2.outline: Return to the fact card, add a second paragraph and a caption under the picture. Peer-check for spelling.
2.sowResources: Word · Docs, peer-check sheet, teacher exemplar. TypingClub warm-up (5-10 min every lesson)

2.outline: Learn one design idea: matching the title colour to something in the picture. Apply it to make the card look joined-up.

2.outline: Print the fact card (or export as PDF) and paste into the class portfolio wall. Present to a partner using two full sentences.

3.outline: Term theme: 'Documents & Photos'. Short diagnostic: log in, open Docs, type a sentence, save. Set a personal TypingClub target.
3.sowResources: Diagnostic checklist, TypingClub goal-setting sheet, term overview poster. TypingClub warm-up (5-10 min every lesson)

3.outline: TypingClub focus: reach up to the top row and down to the bottom row while keeping fingers on the home row.
3.sowResources: TypingClub, wall chart of class accuracy stars. TypingClub warm-up (5-10 min every lesson)

8.outline: Combine conditions with and / or / not. Build a program that decides if someone can ride a rollercoaster (age >= 12 AND height >= 140).
8.sowResources: Thonny, printed truth-table handout. TypingClub warm-up (5-10 min every lesson)

8.outline: Write a test plan before coding: what inputs to try, what outputs are expected. Test one program with normal, boundary and invalid inputs.
8.sowResources: Thonny, printed test-plan template (3 columns: Test Case / Expected / Actual). TypingClub warm-up (5-10 min every lesson)

8.outline: Build a number-guessing game: computer picks a number 1-100, user guesses, program says 'higher', 'lower' or 'correct'. Use a while loop and if / elif.
8.sowResources: Thonny, project brief, worked-example video (Isaac CS). TypingClub warm-up (5-10 min every lesson)

8.outline: Port the guessing game (simpler version, 1-10) to a micro:bit using MakeCode (toggle to Python view to see the same code).
8.sowResources: MakeCode (Blocks + Python view), micro:bit, MakeCode 'Python on micro:bit' guide. TypingClub warm-up (5-10 min every lesson)

8.outline: Debug 3 teacher-made broken programs. Use Thonny's step-through: run one line at a time, watch variable values change.
8.sowResources: Thonny (Debug button), printed 'how to read a Python error' guide, buggy code files. TypingClub warm-up (5-10 min every lesson)

8.outline: Add improvements: input validation (only accept numbers 1-100), a play-again loop, a score counter.
8.sowResources: Thonny, refinement checklist. TypingClub warm-up (5-10 min every lesson)

8.outline: Rotation: (1) write a test plan for a partner's program, (2) find and fix bugs, (3) refactor for clarity. Prepare for the exam.
8.sowResources: Thonny, past-exam-style tasks, TypingClub. TypingClub warm-up (5-10 min every lesson)

8.outline: Individual practical: build a Python mini-app that meets a written brief and passes a written test plan. Show at least one bug found and fixed.
8.sowResources: Marking rubric — from HTML: 'a Python mini-app that passes a written test plan, with at least one bug found and fixed systematically'.

8.outline: Choose ONE project: quiz app, times-tables trainer, tip calculator or password strength checker. Write a plan with inputs, outputs and 3 test cases.
8.sowResources: Thonny, project menu card, planning template. TypingClub warm-up (5-10 min every lesson)

8.outline: Build the project. Use variables, at least one loop and one if-block. Run against your own test plan.
8.sowResources: Thonny, test-plan template. TypingClub warm-up (5-10 min every lesson)

8.outline: Swap with a partner. Peer-tests using YOUR test plan and adds one more test case. Fix any bugs and log them in a bug diary.
8.sowResources: Thonny, peer-test sheet, bug-diary template. TypingClub warm-up (5-10 min every lesson)

8.outline: 3-minute demo of the project: run through the test cases live and explain the code. Save the final .py file + test plan to the portfolio folder.
8.sowResources: Class projector, portfolio folder, presentation rubric. TypingClub warm-up (5-10 min every lesson)

9.outline: Term theme: 'Advanced Documents & Data'. Preview the IGCSE ICT 0417 pathway. Diagnostic: complete a Year 8 document task; set improvement targets.
9.sowResources: IGCSE ICT 0417 spec overview (Cambridge International PDF), diagnostic task, term overview slides. TypingClub warm-up (5-10 min every lesson)

9.outline: Format to a precise brief: 2 columns, drop cap, pull quote, gutter margins, page break before each heading.
9.sowResources: Microsoft Word, Google Docs, IGCSE-style layout brief handout. TypingClub warm-up (5-10 min every lesson)

9.outline: Personalised documents from a data source: build a class certificate that pulls in names from a spreadsheet.
9.sowResources: Word Mail Merge, Excel source data, YouTube: Kevin Stratvert 'Mail Merge in Word'. TypingClub warm-up (5-10 min every lesson)

9.outline: Understand tables, fields and records. Design a small database for a chosen scenario (class library, sports fixtures, cafe menu).
9.sowResources: Microsoft Access OR LibreOffice Base (free, libreoffice.org), database design template. TypingClub warm-up (5-10 min every lesson)

9.outline: Write a query with criteria (e.g. 'show all fiction books'). Add a validation rule (e.g. 'year must be 1900-2026').
9.sowResources: Access / Base, printed queries & validation reference. TypingClub warm-up (5-10 min every lesson)

9.outline: Present database output as a formatted report: grouped headings, running totals, cover page.
9.sowResources: Access / Base, report-design exemplar. TypingClub warm-up (5-10 min every lesson)

9.outline: Complete an IGCSE-style short practical task (30 min): follow a written brief exactly, save to a specific file name. Discuss mark-scheme thinking.
9.sowResources: Past-paper style brief (Cambridge International IGCSE ICT 0417 specimen), marking rubric. TypingClub warm-up (5-10 min every lesson)

9.outline: Return to the brief. Refine layout, spelling, filename, saving format. Learn 'read the brief twice, then start'.
9.sowResources: IGCSE-style brief, refinement checklist. TypingClub warm-up (5-10 min every lesson)

9.outline: Start the term portfolio piece: a document + database combined practical on a chosen scenario. Draft the document.
9.sowResources: Word · Docs, Access / Base, portfolio brief. TypingClub warm-up (5-10 min every lesson)

9.outline: Rotation: (1) advanced layout, (2) database query, (3) mail merge, (4) timed brief. Peer-check against the IGCSE-style rubric.
9.sowResources: Rotation stations, IGCSE-style rubric, TypingClub. TypingClub warm-up (5-10 min every lesson)

9.outline: Individual practical (90 min): follow an IGCSE-style brief that requires an advanced document plus a database query and report.
9.sowResources: Marking rubric — from HTML: 'a document + database practical marked against an IGCSE-style brief'.

9.outline: Build the document to a precise brief: 2 columns, TOC, captioned images, mail-merge fields for personalisation.
9.sowResources: Word · Docs, brief document, exemplar. TypingClub warm-up (5-10 min every lesson)

9.outline: Build the database: 2 related tables OR 1 table with validation, 15+ records, 3 queries answering questions from the brief.
9.sowResources: Access / Base, project brief, queries reference. TypingClub warm-up (5-10 min every lesson)

9.outline: Combine document + database output. Produce a printable / PDF report that a client (real teacher) could actually use.
9.sowResources: Word · Docs, Access / Base, PDF export. TypingClub warm-up (5-10 min every lesson)

9.outline: 5-minute demo to the class as if to a real client: 'here's what you asked for, here's how it works, here are the queries you can run'. Save all files to the portfolio folder.
9.sowResources: Class projector, portfolio folder, client-brief sheet. TypingClub warm-up (5-10 min every lesson)
